segments.title: New RenameForm and protectedProcedure, modified PartyList and pokemonRouter

traceDiagram.title: List and rename own Pokemon flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the app loads the Pokemon of the signed-in trainer through the `mine` query and renders a rename form on each row. It also shows what happens when the trainer types a name or submits the form, and how the new name reaches the party through `renamePokemon()`.

traceNodes.label: Provides the tRPC and query clients to the app
traceNodes.description: When a trainer opens the app, [`createRoot().render()` renders `<App />`](code:src/client/main.tsx#L4).

children.label: Lists the Pokemon of the signed-in trainer
children.description: When a trainer opens the app, [`<App />` renders `<PartyList />`](code:src/client/App.tsx#L13). When the Pokemon of the trainer are loaded, [`api.pokemon.mine.useQuery()`](code:src/client/PartyList.tsx#L5) calls the `mine` procedure of `pokemonRouter`.

children.label: Shows a rename form for one Pokemon
children.description: When the Pokemon of the trainer are loaded, [`<PartyList />` renders `<RenameForm />` on the row of each Pokemon](code:src/client/PartyList.tsx#L12). When a trainer submits the form, the handler calls `rename.mutate()`, and when a trainer types a name, the handler stores the draft.

triggerLabels.label: The Pokemon of the signed-in trainer are loaded

Renders one row with a rename form per Pokemon

traceNodes.label: Builds a procedure that runs requireTrainer first
traceNodes.description:
Two paths reach this procedure, because [`mine`](code:src/server/routers/pokemon.ts#L12) and [`rename`](code:src/server/routers/pokemon.ts#L14) are built on it:

- When the Pokemon of the trainer are loaded, `api.pokemon.mine.useQuery()` sends a request that tRPC runs through `requireTrainer` before the `mine` resolver.
- When a trainer submits the rename form, `rename.mutate()` sends a request that tRPC runs through `requireTrainer` before the `rename` resolver.

traceNodes.description: When a client calls a procedure of `pokemon`, tRPC runs it from this router, because [`appRouter` joins it under the key `pokemon`](code:src/server/root.ts#L6).

traceNodes.label: Calls the rename procedure on the server
traceNodes.description: When a trainer submits the rename form, [the handler calls `rename.mutate()`](code:src/client/RenameForm.tsx#L14), and the mutation sends the id and the draft name to the `rename` procedure. When the server confirms the rename, the mutation runs `onSuccess`.

traceNodes.description: When the server confirms the rename, [`api.pokemon.rename.useMutation()`](code:src/client/RenameForm.tsx#L7) calls this callback, which calls `utils.pokemon.mine.invalidate()`.
